functionDeclarations.description:
Called when the user asks for weather related information.
Ensure the user's location (city or region) is provided.
When given a location, please estimate the latitude and longitude of the location and
do not ask the user for them.
functionDeclarations.name: lookup_weather

location.description: The location they are asking for
location.title: Location

latitude.description: The latitude of the location, do not ask user for it
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: The longitude of the location, do not ask user for it
longitude.title: Longitude
